name: Green Power Group Limited
summary: Operating as an investment holding firm, Acme International Holdings Limited provides full-spectrum design and construction solutions for building exteriors and their specialized maintenance unit (BMU) systems across Hong Kong and Macau. Their service offerings are extensive, encompassing conceptualization, producing detailed technical drawings and structural analyses, procuring necessary building components and BMU equipment, executing installation with logistical precision, overseeing on-site activities, delivering ongoing maintenance post-completion, and ensuring robust project management. The company, which originated in 1989, has its primary offices situated in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
